instruction:
In the container, the Go repository github.com/labstack/echo/v4 is checked out at /echo. Do NOT modify any file. Your job is only to gather baseline information.

Run these commands and report the raw output:
1. `cd /echo && go version && git log --oneline -5 && git status --porcelain`
2. `cd /echo && go test ./... 2>&1 | tail -40` (this may take a couple of minutes; be patient, do not kill it)
3. `cd /echo && go test ./... 2>&1 | grep -E '^(ok|FAIL|---)' `

Report: the go version, the git log/status output, the exact list of failing tests (package + test name + failure message), and confirmation that all other packages pass. Keep the report concise but complete.

You are working in the Go repo github.com/labstack/echo/v4 checked out at /echo (module github.com/labstack/echo/v4, go1.16 toolchain). Make ONLY the following edit in /echo/router.go and nothing else.

Bug: when no route matches, `Context.Path()` must return "" (empty string), because `Path()` is documented in context.go as "Path returns the registered path for the handler". Today `Router.Find` unconditionally executes `ctx.path = path` (the *request* path) at its start, so unmatched requests report the requested URL as the route path.

Fix: in `func (r *Router) Find(method, path string, c Context)`, delete the single line

	ctx.path = path

that appears immediately after `ctx := c.(*context)` (currently around line 342). Do NOT delete or change the later `ctx.path = currentNode.ppath` line (around line 484). Do not change any other line: the `path` parameter is still used further down in the function, so nothing else needs to change.

Do not touch any other file. Do not add, modify or delete tests.

Then run and report the raw output of:
- `cd /echo && gofmt -l router.go`
- `cd /echo && go build ./... && go vet ./`
- `cd /echo && go test ./ -count=1 2>&1 | tail -30`
- `cd /echo && git diff -- router.go`

Report: the diff, the command outputs, and any failure. Keep it concise.

Repo github.com/labstack/echo/v4 at /echo (go1.16). Six source files were just modified by other agents: bind.go, context.go, group.go, router.go, middleware/compress.go, middleware/proxy.go. Do NOT modify any file. Just verify and report.

Run and report the raw output of:
- `cd /echo && git status --porcelain --untracked-files=all`
- `cd /echo && git diff --stat`
- `cd /echo && gofmt -l .`
- `cd /echo && go vet ./...`
- `cd /echo && go test -count=1 ./...`
- `cd /echo && go test -race -count=1 ./...`

Report concisely: whether the tree contains ONLY those six modified files and no stray/untracked files (especially no leftover *_test.go files added by anyone), and whether every test passes (list any FAIL with the test name and message). Do not change anything.
